notes.title: Patch 0.1.7 - Sept 25th, 2025
notes.notes:

 Adjusted harvesting minigames so poisonous items don't display unlocked recipes
 Added new music theme for Bramblecliff Abbey


Fixes


 Fixed issue where quest indicators on compass wouldn't refresh with player direction while riding Berta
 Fixed some instances where footstep sounds would play incorrectly for the surface

notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3 - August 25st, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes


 Increased coin value of favours by 20% and increased the maximum items sellable in a single market to 20.
 In practice, this should increase player coin income by 15-25% depending on playstyle. More adjustments will come to project costs in future patches as needed.
 Several changes and in-game clarifications on how item decay works. For the sake of clarity, here is how it works as of this patch:
 Unsorted items in the basket decay at end of each day.
 Sorted foraged parts in your inventory decay after completion of the upcoming market event.
 A warning now comes up at the start of markets indicating this.
 Skipping or cancelling a market will delay item decay.
 Crafted items will fully decay on market completion if they had a red indicator on their icon in the inventory prior to the market.
 As a consequence of this update, crafted items in existing inventories will have their decay durations reset to full.
 Reworked the Tutorial text and changed when the tutorial pops up.
 Fast travel has been re-enabled to test a potential fix for infinite loading screens when teleporting to Elder Moor and Portobello Woods.
 If you still encounter any issues with fast travel, please let us know!
 Favours will only generate for items that you have discovered all parts for and unlocked necessary harvesting tools for. No more impossible favours!
 Existing favours in your current day are not affected. These rules only impact newly generated favours.
 Updated the "interaction particle" for certain quest objectives and discoverable community projects to be more noticeable.
 Added a customization mirror to the community kitchen that allows changing clothes and character appearance.
 Added rotation button to the customization menu to rotate the character by 90 degrees.
 Swapped the position of the Camera and Calendar apps on the phone. This should make accessing the calendar from the phone easier, as it eliminates the need to navigate to page 2.
 Added a fullscreen/windowed toggle box to graphics settings.
 When in windowed mode, players can drag the window edge to resize it as needed. If you swap to windowed mode, you might find it is the same size as your display, so it can be tricky to drag the window edges to resize. Try using the Windows hotkey for full-screen toggle (F11) if you have trouble with this. We will provide more detailed resolution settings in a future update.
 Item crafting favours will now be completable immediately if you have the required item already crafted.
 Note that this does not affect already accepted favours. Only newly generated favours will behave this way.


Fixes


 Fixed an issue with Granny's last quest (so far) that was preventing it from being offered at the end of her questline.
 Fixed an instance where community projects in Our Porto would have their title partially cut off if pinned.
 Fixed an issue that could cause several interfaces not to update correctly, even though progress was technically happening. This was most noticeable with friendship levels and quest tracking.
 Fixed some community projects not pinning and unpinning correctly relative to their respective quests.
 Updated some hints for various quests for objective clarity.
 Fixed typos in plant descriptions.
 Fixed grammatical error in foraging patch prompt when basket full.
 Fixed typo in "Brewing Up Ideas" quest

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2 - August 15th, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes

- Increased streaming pool size from 1000MB to 2000MB.This is our first attempt to address blurry models for plants during identification, harvesting, and sorting. Please let us know if you continue experiencing this issue, and we will investigate further.
- Moved immersive mode setting from General to Graphics tab.Added left click as option for advancing dialogue.
- Added settings to invert camera X and Y axis.
- Added "skip" option in forest bathing to fix an issue where the player could get locked in forest bathing if an obstacle blocked the path between the player and the bathing spot. The original issue this was made to solve has been resolved, but the skip button will remain for now if people wish to use it.

Fixes

- Fixed an issue preventing players from progressing Annie's Nettle Farm quest.
- Fixed save files affected by the bugged Annie's Nettle Farm quest if players had completed the project before this patch.
- Fixed an issue causing some quest objectives to not update correctly.
- Fixed an issue where the player could trigger Charles' community project discovery dialogue while in photo mode.
- Updated meditation spots to prevent players from getting stuck while walking to their centres.
- Fixed an issue where player movement could break if initiating forest bathing while already on the correct spot.
- Fixed a typo in Barbara's "The Taste of Childhood" quest.
- Fixed typo in Charles' "Dash of Colour" quest
- Fixed an issue where time was incorrectly set to morning on fresh saves.
- Fixed missing community spirit reward for Linda's tier 3 friendship quest.
- Fixed issue where player had jumping enabled indoors when loading a save from the community kitchen, allowing player to escape bounds.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 - August 12th, 2025
notes.notes:
Changes
- Disabled fast travel temporarily to avoid issues with players getting infinite loading screens while we work on a proper fix.
- Added a link to the community discord as well as the most recent patch notes and known issues list to the main menu.
- Swapped the day transition video for an in-game cinematic version for visual quality and stability.

Fixes
- Fixed an issue where players could get stuck on Annie's Nettle Farm friendship quest if they'd already unlocked the Nettle Farm beforehand.
- Fixed an issue where Quests completed during game load by patch fixes would record the wrong quest completion times.
- Fixed an issue where Quests completed during game load by patch fixes would not show in the quest journal as 'Completed'.
- Fixed blocker allowing player to reach Waveward Beach without completing "Access to Waveward Beach" community project.
- Fixed an issue where players who quit the game before reaching the first autosave in the first quest would lose their starting items.
- Fixed an issue where players who quit the game before reaching the first autosave in the first quest would not see storefront items.
- Fixed an issue where players who quit the game before reaching the first autosave in the first quest would have their characters appear broken (every category displayed as Skin Details and not starting with the default character) in customisation until randomising.
- Fixed a dandelion and coltsfoot patch at Ginkgo's rest that was very difficult to photograph.
- Fixed typos in various quests 
- Fixed several quests where NPCs would teleport away unintentionally
- Adjusted blocking volumes in various areas to prevent outmapping and getting stuck.
- Prevented premature unlocking of the nettle farm project that would break quest progression if completed before the appropriate quest.
Note: save files already affected by this bug will be fixed in an upcoming patch. - 
- Added missing Angel's Wings foraging patches.
- Fixed some grass and landscape issues around Granny's house.

notes.title: The release button is back! Out now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!



The release button has appeared again so we pressed it as quickly as we could! The game is now LIVE! How exciting!!



Thank you all for your patience and kindness and understanding surrounding the delay issues we had 🙏🏻🙏🏻❤️❤️ you’re the best community we could hope for!



We hope this game brings you lots of joy and connection to nature, and we will work hard to improve it for you. So please join our discord (link on our website).



If you can leave a review for us, that would be amazing! Our kickstarter backers reviews won’t count towards the algorithm (since steam thinks they received the game for free) so only you can help us with this 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻 



Also, here are some known bugs and issues:



Major Issues:

Fast travelling to Portobello Woods and Elder Moor can lead to infinite loading screens requiring reloading the game. Use fast travel with caution for now.



One Annie quest requires you to build a Nettle farm but unfortunately you can unlock the project beforehand and it blocks the quest. Please don’t do the nettle farm community project until it appears as Annies quest.



The mushroom Angel Wings is currently missing and will be added on the next patch.



Minor issues:

Harvesting, Identification, and Sorting

Some foraging patches have nodes floating slightly above or below the terrain.Please tell us which ones look wrong, we might not have seen it!Some foraging patches have cameras in incorrect positions. Let us know which cameras aren't capturing their good sides.



Recipes, Maker's Club, and Community Projects

Community Projects complete immediately rather than at the start of the next day. Recipe book/maker's club NPC bonuses do not preview before being chosen.



thank you all! ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

notes.title: The Release Button is Gone. (Literally.)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,



we're heartbroken to say this but we can't release today. We literally can't press the button. It's gone.



The game is ready to go, everything was prepared - but since this is our first release ever, we forgot to tick the "Early Access" checkbox on the Steam backend until this morning. And once that is ticked, Steam automatically put our Steam page in review  mode- a normal process on their end but for us it couldn't have come at a worse time. This has caused the release button to disappear, we cannot click it. 



So we can't launch T-T 



We were super stressed about this all morning, we wrote tickets to Steam. But they're on PDT time where it was still the middle of the night. 



We don't know if Steam will accelerate our review, we can't assume anything since they are very busy. Reviews usually take 3-5 days. So we're stuck with just one option: to delay the release until Monday.



We're so sorry, to all of you who were looking forward to this game launching today. We're extremely sad since we worked so hard to get everything ready for you. Our backers have received overwrite keys so they can already play today, but everyone else will need to wait until the release button shows up again, and we can press it.



This is all due to our inexperience, we never released a game before and didn't know about the Early Access tickbox and its implications. All I can say is...



WE'RE SO SOORRRYYYYY T-T [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/b41d83f7ed1a02acb665ce4acce5b171838c1b04.png"]

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!


We have some huge news! Out and About is launching into Early Access on Steam on August 7th! 🎉


Thank you for being part of this incredible journey! We started with a dream to create a cozy, nature-loving adventure and now, after years of hard work (and your amazing support!), we’re almost ready to share it with you.


What does the game look like at Early Access?
🍄 Learn to identify 55+ real plants, fungi and seaweeds!
🍳 Cook over 90+ tasty recipes and sell them at the local market!
💖 Build friendships with the neighbours of Portobello, which includes 3 friendship levels and special quests!
🏠 Restore your childhood home and bring life back to the community! We'll have dozens of community projects for you to do!



Altogether we estimate the gameplay time to be 17-25h! 🥳

As you know, we wanted to create something more than "just" a game, a little love letter to nature, filled with real-world knowledge about foraging, cooking, and seasonal living. Every plant and fungus you find in-game is based on real species, with actual identification tips to help you learn as you play.


This Early Access launch is just the beginning. Your feedback is going to be essential as we add even more recipes, plants, and cozy adventures to Portobello. 



Here's an idea what you can expect over the course of Early Access:

a ridable mount

new seasons

new plants, minigames and recipes

new chapters of the story

new friendship levels and quests

new features

and many improvements based on the feedback you and the community give us!


Thank you so much for helping us get here. We can’t wait to see you out in the fields (virtually speaking!) on August 7th.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/2737fa18a2fff7f95485b25210ec0fe5c6b94c84.png"]
💚 The Out and About Team

notes.title: Developer Update January
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 🌈

I hope you all had a restful festive season and a good start into the new year! 2025 will be our most exciting year so we're really looking forward to it!

As you know, we want to release Out and About into Early Access on PC in Spring! We can't yet tell you when exactly (it's still a secret) 😉 but it won't be too long!

So let's look at some of the things we worked on in January! 

New Music Direction
We hadn't been able to invest in music in a long time, but last year we finally got to create a few more pieces. However, the direction of the music changed because the game itself had grown and changed. Now, the focus is much more on relaxation and nature. Have a listen to this sample of the forest music and tell us what you think!

[previewyoutube=EYj7ygnm4tQ;full][/previewyoutube]

New Sea Shader
Our artist Niko recently reworked our water shader and blew us away with the result. It's hard to remember our old water now that we have seen this beautiful shader in action. It's almost like our minds forcefully forgot it - we'll have to find some old videos to compare them one day! 🤣

[previewyoutube=N2uCOjpyBy0;full][/previewyoutube]


Filler NPCs for a more lively world
If you played our demo, you know that our beautiful little town feels a bit like a ghost town - but now we created a wide range of characters that we can place in the world to make it feel more lively. Since this is our first game, there is lots to learn about NPC navigation (and performance relating to that), so we'll have to start with the basics. But we're sure that this will already have an enormous effect on the liveliness of the world, so we're very excited to implement them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/e4a63b8bbed6081376fb9574896603a66d6cd185.png

Barbara's Farm
Barbara is your foraging teacher, but her family also owned a farm outside town. Now Barbara wants to restore it, and combine traditional farming with Paludiculture (= productive land use of wet and rewetted peatlands). We're excited to integrate this into the game and shed some light on this topic. Here are some concept sketches of the farm and the colored version we chose!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/35e22435db588e455865502fd9e313c0e9461234.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/01859a1c764195e122590ee52a9e991ea2c3e072.png

As you can see, we went for a combination of Nr 3 and 1. Which number of the concept art would you have chosen?


That's it for this month's update! Take care and have a good week everyone!

Jen & Elena💖

notes.title: November Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! ✨

We've been creating monthly updates on Kickstarter for a year now, additionally to our 3 posts on TikTok per week, but we hadn't posted any of this here. Which must have completely slipped my mind and obviously needs to change! 

Outfit Concept Art!
Here’s some concept art we created a while ago and are now creating as 3D models. We can't wait to finally have new starter outfits, and new outfits in general, since we had the old outfit for ages now and do not like it anymore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/5c9c47cc8b6f8859f4f291385f0175d9bf6b4ccb.jpg

We would love to hear about your preferences for clothing! So join our Discord (link at the bottom) and talk to us there!

Community Garden
As you know this game is about highlighting community and how we can come together. So of course our little town has a community garden! The community garden will be a place for the NPCs to have their own garden lots and grow their favourite vegetables and fruit, which they will share with you. There will be a long list of community projects for you to rebuild and grow this garden, unlocking more and more as the game progresses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/4efa28e59f859fa7f648832200dd2b67d7524d9f.png
This is not final and will likely change and adapt in the future as we continue implementing it, but what is certain is that it will be a beautiful place for you to rebuild and bond with characters!

And of course we're planning for beautiful and sustainable gardening methods inspired by real-life references!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/0f16386def74b426df505b87882b81b3bba893ff.png

Storefronts UI
We're working on a list of UIs related to new systems, and the storefronts are part of that. This UI shows the general layout of storefronts, where you can buy essential items, and special ones too! This is only a FIRST DRAFT :) Every store will have a different store keeper, decorations and color scheme.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888139/e5cab91fc08378723bda1161e42b2aee5b9abbbe.png

Past Kickstarter Updates:
If you want to see our past updates, check out our Kickstarter updates page!

Join Our Discord!
Don't forget to join our Discord so that you get updates and news, and can ask us questions directly!


Have a great day everyone!
